This man broke one wall in his basement...
and behind it, he found a lost city.
Cold air was coming out of the hole.
So he grabbed a lamp... and crawled in.
A tunnel. Stairs. Another tunnel. Down, and down, and down.
Eight levels. Eighty five meters deep.
And every level had a stone door... that only closes from the inside.
Because this city wasn't built to live in. It was built to hide.
When raiders came, they found empty houses... and silence.
Today, you can walk down those same stairs.
So if an old wall ever feels cold... remember, it all started when...
